goal.en: Say the same thing three ways, and know exactly which room each version belongs in.
goal.ar: أن تقول الشيء نفسه بثلاث صيغ، وتعرف تماماً أين تصلح كل صيغة.

head: Register
Same message
rows: We messed up the dates — sorry, let's redo it.
We got the dates wrong. I'll send a corrected version today.
An error occurred in the scheduling. A corrected version will follow today.
The scheduling discrepancy is acknowledged. A revised document will be issued.

text.en: Register is chosen by the relationship and the setting, not by how important you want to sound. Formality above the situation reads as distance or evasion.
text.ar: يُختار مستوى اللغة بحسب العلاقة والسياق، لا بحسب رغبتك في الظهور بمظهر مهم. والرسمية الزائدة عن الموقف تُقرأ تباعداً أو تهرّباً.

text.en: Notice what the formal versions above lose: the word “we”. As register rises, the agent disappears — which is sometimes precisely the point.
text.ar: لاحظ ما تفقده الصيغ الرسمية أعلاه: كلمة «نحن». فكلما ارتفع المستوى اختفى الفاعل، وهذا أحياناً هو المقصود بالضبط.

text.en: A euphemism is fair when it spares feelings and unfair when it hides responsibility. The test is whether the plain version names someone the soft version does not.
text.ar: التلطيف مقبول حين يراعي المشاعر، ومرفوض حين يخفي المسؤولية. والاختبار: هل تُسمّي الصيغة الصريحة فاعلاً تُغفله الصيغة اللطيفة؟

text.en: English-speaking workplaces vary, but professional English generally softens instructions and sharpens facts. Softening a fact and sharpening an instruction is the wrong way round.
text.ar: تختلف بيئات العمل الناطقة بالإنجليزية، لكن الإنجليزية المهنية عموماً تُليّن التوجيهات وتُحدّد الوقائع. أما تليين الواقعة وتشديد التوجيه فعكس الصواب.

head: Too soft
Calibrated
Too blunt
rows: Maybe we could possibly look at it?
Could you review this by Thursday?
There may be some small issues.
There are two errors on page four.
Your work is full of errors.
It might be slightly late perhaps.
It will be two days late.

text.en: Vagueness is not politeness. “There may be some issues” forces the reader to guess; “there are two errors on page four” is both polite and useful.
text.ar: الغموض ليس تهذيباً. فعبارة «قد تكون هناك بعض المشكلات» تُجبر القارئ على التخمين، أما «هناك خطآن في الصفحة الرابعة» فمهذبة ونافعة معاً.

prompt.en: You are emailing a close colleague about your own scheduling error. Which fits?
prompt.ar: تراسل زميلاً مقرباً بشأن خطأ منك في المواعيد. أي صيغة تناسب؟

options: I got the dates wrong — sorry. Corrected version coming today.
An error occurred in the scheduling of the aforementioned tasks.
The scheduling discrepancy is acknowledged and will be rectified.
It has been determined that the dates were recorded incorrectly.

explanation.en: With a close colleague, plain ownership is right; the formal versions all remove the person responsible.
explanation.ar: مع زميل مقرب تصلح الصراحة وتحمّل المسؤولية، أما الصيغ الرسمية فتحذف المسؤول جميعاً.

prompt.en: The same error, now in a formal notice to a client. Which fits?
prompt.ar: الخطأ نفسه، لكن في إشعار رسمي لعميل. أي صيغة تناسب؟

options: We made an error in the schedule and will issue a corrected version today.
We messed up the dates, sorry about that, we'll sort it out today.
The scheduling discrepancy is acknowledged by the relevant parties.
Errors of this kind are known to occur in scheduling processes.

explanation.en: Formal but accountable. The last two use formality to avoid saying who was responsible.
explanation.ar: رسمية مع تحمّل المسؤولية. أما الأخيرتان فتستخدمان الرسمية للتهرب من ذكر المسؤول.

prompt.en: What is usually lost as register rises?
prompt.ar: ما الذي يُفقد عادةً كلما ارتفع مستوى اللغة؟

options: The person who did the action.
The date the action happened.
The seriousness of the problem.
The name of the document.

explanation.en: Formal English favours passives and nominalisations, both of which can drop the agent.
explanation.ar: تفضّل الإنجليزية الرسمية المبني للمجهول والصيغ الاسمية، وكلاهما قد يُسقط الفاعل.

prompt.en: Match the setting with the phrasing that fits it.

explanation.en: The content is identical in all four; only the relationship changes.
explanation.ar: المضمون واحد في الأربع، والمتغيّر هو العلاقة فقط.

prompt.en: Which euphemism is evasive rather than kind?
prompt.ar: أي تلطيف يُعدّ تهرباً لا مراعاة؟

options: Mistakes were made in the handling of the account.
Her grandfather passed away earlier this year.
Forty staff were made redundant in March.
The team had a challenging final quarter.

explanation.en: It hides who made them. The others soften a fact without removing anyone from it.
explanation.ar: تخفي من ارتكبها. أما البقية فتُلطّف الواقعة دون حذف أحد منها.

prompt.en: A company reports “a period of negative growth”. What has happened?
prompt.ar: أعلنت شركة عن a period of negative growth. ماذا حدث؟

options: Its revenue fell during that period.
Its revenue grew more slowly than hoped.
Its revenue stayed exactly the same.
Its revenue grew in a different market.

explanation.en: “Negative growth” is a decline wearing a better coat. Recognising it protects you as a reader.
explanation.ar: «النمو السالب» انخفاضٌ في ثوب أجمل، والتعرّف عليه يحمي القارئ.

prompt.en: You must tell a team their project is cancelled. Which is right?
prompt.ar: عليك إبلاغ فريق بإلغاء مشروعه. أي صيغة صحيحة؟

options: I'm sorry to say the project has been cancelled. Here is why.
The project has entered a period of indefinite strategic pause.
There have been some developments regarding the project's future.
The project is being reconceptualised in line with new priorities.

explanation.en: People forgive bad news; they do not forgive being managed. The euphemisms delay the same blow.
explanation.ar: يتقبّل الناس الخبر السيئ، ولا يتقبّلون المراوغة. والصيغ الملطّفة تؤجّل الضربة نفسها.

prompt.en: Match the euphemism with its plain meaning.

explanation.en: Translating back into plain terms is how you check what you are actually being told.
explanation.ar: إعادة الترجمة إلى اللغة الصريحة هي وسيلتك للتحقق مما يُقال لك فعلاً.

prompt.en: You need a colleague to review a document by Thursday. Which is best?
prompt.ar: تحتاج مراجعة زميل لمستند بحلول الخميس. ما الأفضل؟

options: Could you review this by Thursday? Happy to talk it through first.
Maybe at some point we could possibly look at this together?
Review this and get it back to me before Thursday morning.
It would be great if someone reviewed this at some stage.

explanation.en: A softened instruction with a hard deadline. The vague versions produce no action; the blunt one produces resentment.
explanation.ar: توجيه ملطّف مع موعد حاسم. أما الصيغ المبهمة فلا تُنتج فعلاً، والفظّة تُنتج امتعاضاً.

prompt.en: You found two errors in a colleague's report. How do you say it?
prompt.ar: وجدت خطأين في تقرير زميل. كيف تقول ذلك؟

options: There are two errors on page four — the totals in the second table.
There may possibly be some small issues somewhere in the report.
Your report is full of errors and needs to be done again.
I noticed some things that perhaps might need another look.

explanation.en: Sharpen the fact, soften the instruction. Vagueness here is not kindness — it wastes their time.
explanation.ar: حدّد الواقعة وليّن التوجيه. والغموض هنا ليس لطفاً بل إهدار لوقت زميلك.

prompt.en: Why is “There may be some issues” a poor way to report a fault?
prompt.ar: لماذا تُعدّ عبارة There may be some issues طريقة ضعيفة للإبلاغ عن خلل؟

options: It leaves the reader guessing what and where.
It is grammatically incorrect in written English.
It is too formal for a workplace message.
It accuses the reader of making the errors.

explanation.en: Politeness belongs in how you ask, not in whether the reader can find the problem.
explanation.ar: التهذيب محلّه أسلوب الطلب، لا قدرة القارئ على العثور على المشكلة.

prompt.en: Which reply declines a request clearly but without damage?
prompt.ar: أي رد يرفض الطلب بوضوح ودون ضرر؟

options: I can't take this on this week, but I could start on Monday.
I'll try to fit it in somewhere if I possibly get a chance.
No. I have far too much other work to do right now.
That is really not my responsibility, as you well know.

explanation.en: A clear no with an alternative. “I'll try” without capacity is a yes that fails later.
explanation.ar: رفض واضح مع بديل. أما «سأحاول» بلا قدرة فهي موافقة تفشل لاحقاً.

prompt.en: Which sentence is too formal for a message to a teammate?
prompt.ar: أي جملة أرسم من اللازم في رسالة إلى زميل في الفريق؟

options: Kindly be advised that the aforementioned file has been transmitted.
I've sent the file over — let me know if anything looks off.
I've sent you the file. Shout if you spot any problems.
The file is with you now; tell me if something is missing.

explanation.en: “Kindly be advised” and “aforementioned” belong to legal notices, not to a teammate.
explanation.ar: عبارتا kindly be advised وaforementioned من لغة الإشعارات القانونية لا من مخاطبة زميل.

prompt.en: Put it plainly in one word: “The department experienced a period of negative growth.” → “Revenue ___ .”

explanation.en: If a plain word exists, the long version is doing work other than describing.
explanation.ar: إذا وُجدت كلمة صريحة فإن الصيغة الطويلة تؤدي عملاً غير الوصف.

prompt.en: Which sentence gets the balance right in a performance conversation?
prompt.ar: أي جملة تحقق التوازن في حديث عن الأداء؟

options: Your analysis is strong; the writing needs work, and here's what I mean.
Everything is fine, though maybe one or two things could be better.
The writing is bad and I don't understand what you were thinking.
There are aspects of the work that some people might question.

explanation.en: Specific on both the strength and the problem, with an offer to explain — that is what makes feedback usable.
explanation.ar: تحديد نقطة القوة والمشكلة معاً مع عرض التوضيح، وهذا ما يجعل الملاحظات قابلة للاستعمال.
